verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-request opening and scanning of mail contents, not just envelope images, with a stated turnaround: scan requests are usually processed within 6 business hours, and served legal documents are scanned the same day. Scans are kept in unlimited cloud storage with 24/7 access. Missing for 10: no evidence that scans are searchable (OCR) PDFs, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of the turnaround claim.
